title: units of measure: translate organization-added unit labels (deferred by the units ADR, 2A)
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CajiB6BSQKWowy6YLB

Deferred by the maintainer's pick 2A on #35339 (ruling record 7003532733): an organization-added unit of measure carries one label, written by the organization in its own language. Translating those labels is this card. Standard (UN/ECE Rec 20) codes are out of scope here: they get a platform-shipped per-locale label table in R1.

## Why it is deferred, not done
- No row-data translation mechanism exists. Every translation group and `translate*` function overlays a metadata document; org-owned rows such as `sys_queue` carry a single label.
- The authored translation layer is process-wide across organizations (`packages/core/src/fallbacks/authored-translation-sync.ts`), while org unit codes are per organization, so putting them in the translation bundle is unsafe today.
- Evidence: project file `objectstack-seat5/area-ux/data-2/decision-35339-adr-open-items.md`, decision 2.

## Done when
An organization can give an org-added unit a label per platform locale (e.g. a per-locale label map on the org unit row, or a row-data translation mechanism if one lands first), the console shows the viewer's locale with the single label as fallback, and a pin covers one translated and one untranslated unit.

## Blocked-by
Blocked-by: #35339

## Grade
p3 · domain:spec / data. No customer is waiting; the single label works for one-language organizations. Not dispatched alone.
